description: Shared AFD protocol conformance cases (spec/protocol-conformance.md; #1739): discovery, exposure and D4 hiding, batch, pipe, contexts (both MCP eras), and schema validation of every result against spec/schema/{result,batch,pipeline,stream}.json.

streamSupport.python: not exposed on the stdio todo backend
streamSupport.rust: not exposed on the stdio todo backend
streamSupport.cpp: not exposed on the stdio todo backend

streamCases.name: stream_todo_list_sse
streamCases.description: HTTP SSE /stream/todo-list emits StreamChunk frames matching spec/schema/stream.json and terminates with a complete chunk

tests.name: discover_lists_exposed_commands
tests.description: afd-discover lists exposed commands and omits meta-tools

tests.name: discover_search_filters
tests.description: afd-discover filters commands by search term

tests.name: discover_hides_private_command_d4
tests.description: D4: afd-discover never reveals a command whose expose.mcp is false

tests.name: detail_exposed_command
tests.description: afd-detail returns metadata and inputSchema for an exposed command

tests.name: detail_unknown_command
tests.description: afd-detail reports found: false and COMMAND_NOT_FOUND for an unknown name

tests.name: detail_private_command_hidden_d4
tests.description: D4: afd-detail answers a private command identically to an unknown one

tests.name: call_via_afd_call_exposed
tests.description: afd-call invokes an exposed command and returns a valid CommandResult

tests.name: call_unknown_tool_direct
tests.description: Direct tools/call for an unknown tool returns COMMAND_NOT_FOUND with a suggestion

tests.name: call_private_tool_direct_d4
tests.description: D4: direct tools/call for an unexposed command returns COMMAND_NOT_FOUND

tests.name: call_unknown_via_afd_call
tests.description: afd-call for an unknown command returns COMMAND_NOT_FOUND

tests.name: call_private_via_afd_call_d4
tests.description: D4: afd-call for an unexposed command returns COMMAND_NOT_FOUND

tests.name: batch_multi_command_success
tests.description: afd-batch executes multiple commands and returns a BatchResult matching spec/schema/batch.json

tests.name: batch_partial_failure
tests.description: afd-batch reports partial success when one item fails

tests.name: batch_stop_on_error
tests.description: afd-batch with stopOnError skips remaining items with COMMAND_SKIPPED

tests.name: batch_d4_unknown_and_private
tests.description: D4: unknown and unexposed commands inside afd-batch both fail with COMMAND_NOT_FOUND

tests.name: batch_invalid_empty_envelope
tests.description: afd-batch rejects an empty commands array with INVALID_BATCH_REQUEST

tests.name: pipe_variable_passing
tests.description: afd-pipe chains steps via $steps.<alias>.<field> and returns a PipelineResult matching spec/schema/pipeline.json

tests.name: pipe_when_condition_skips
tests.description: afd-pipe skips a step whose when condition evaluates to false

tests.name: pipe_failure_stops_later_steps
tests.description: afd-pipe stops on a failing step and skips subsequent steps

tests.name: pipe_d4_private_command
tests.description: D4: an unexposed command inside afd-pipe fails with COMMAND_NOT_FOUND

tests.name: pipe_invalid_envelope
tests.description: afd-pipe rejects a blank step command with INVALID_PIPELINE_REQUEST

tests.name: context_list_configured
tests.description: afd-context-list returns the server's configured contexts in both MCP eras

tests.name: context_legacy_enter_allows_read
tests.description: Legacy era: entering todo-reading allows todo-list on the session

tests.name: context_legacy_enter_blocks_edit
tests.description: Legacy era: entering todo-reading blocks todo-create with COMMAND_NOT_IN_CONTEXT

tests.name: context_legacy_unknown_context
tests.description: Legacy era: entering an unknown context returns CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND

tests.name: context_modern_meta_allows_read
tests.description: Modern era: _meta["dev.afd/context"]="todo-reading" allows todo-list statelessly

tests.name: context_modern_meta_blocks_edit_statelessly
tests.description: Modern era: _meta["dev.afd/context"]="todo-reading" blocks todo-create without leaking into the next request
